product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Bayard Contemporary Upholstered Couch with Curved Back and Armrests, 76"W, Dark Grey
product.description: Tapered legs, a rounded back and armrests, and a chic dark-gray upholstery give this couch a contemporary feel, but this design is classic enough to blend with any decor. A solid wood frame and foam padding in the cushions make it a sturdy and comfortable place to relax. 76.0"W x 34.3"D x 32.7"H; seat height: 17.7"H; seat depth: 21.2"D; seat back height: 16.53"H; arm height: 24.8"H; leg height: 8.27"H Solid wood frame; polyester, linen, and rayon upholstery This couch combines chic, contemporary design elements in a classic structure, making it the perfect fit wherever you need seating. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
